name: Visual Music player
summary:
Rediscover your favourite music in VR. Play local MP3 or FLAC files and follow a moving arrow, colourful 3D trail and glowing ball as they respond to the song. Enjoy melodies, rhythm and musical highs and lows in a refreshing, satisfying experience.

BRING YOUR MUSIC
Open a music file, add a folder or scan your headset with your permission. Original audio starts while on-device analysis prepares the movement. The same arrow follows prominent singing and instruments; results vary with each recording.
